title: U.S. State Department Reportedly Presented AI-Generated Map That Mislabeled Every Labeled African Country
summary: During a U.S. State Department presentation at the AIDS 2026 conference in Rio de Janeiro, a map carrying an OpenAI provenance signal reportedly mislabeled every African country shown with a label. The department attributed the slide to a team member's rushed revision and accepted responsibility for the resulting confusion and misrepresentation.
